findings.reason: the declaration is the only machine-readable state a dispatcher reads, so leaving it `implementable` makes the recorded hold inert and sends a node into section 6 against the decision that is meant to gate it.
findings.text: `plan-section-declarations` marks s6, s7 and s8 `implementable`, but the decision added at line 120 is unanswered and its own context reads "Sections 6 and 7 are held on this decision"; a build queue reads the declaration, so s6 is dispatchable with no model chosen even though section 6's own text says the writer is "the one the lead chose"

findings.reason: the one number the section can fail on is set from a different instrument than the one that measures it, so the author must restate the bar from the hand reading or say which instrument's rate it borrows.
findings.text: the bar of "at most eight of the forty are wrong" is justified as "the paid model's measured rate of 32 wrong in 200", but 32 in 200 is 16% and eight in forty is 20%, and the 32 figure is the automated judge's count in refine-local-model-signal-enrichment.html while section 6 measures by hand, the instrument on which the same paid model measured 0 wrong in 40 and the local model 26 in 40; the bar therefore passes a quality the cited instrument would fail and is claimed to be the cited rate when it is a quarter looser

findings.reason: the plan currently carries a settled answer and an open answer to the same question for the same sections, and the held decision is only meaningful if the earlier choice is cleared or recorded as superseded.
findings.text: the `description-model` decision remains locked to `local-after-retest` with the local option marked chosen, and its rationale ends "Sections 6 and 7 stay unbuilt until the lead confirms the local model on this result or chooses otherwise", while the plan records that confirmation as a new open decision at line 120 whose options include the paid model; two decision elements with `data-sections="s6,s7"` now answer the same question in opposite states and no line says the earlier choice is superseded, so a reader who takes the locked choice at line 93 dispatches sections 6 and 7 on the local model
